nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement the output-scheduling portion of Ferryx terminal scale support with a faithful RED→GREEN test.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts` and `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts` (plus a narrow related helper file only if absolutely necessary) to batch each terminal renderer's output writes at animation-frame cadence, preserving session output order and safe teardown. Return exact changed paths, RED and GREEN command transcripts, and a concise explanation.
SCOPE: Do not modify `workspaceStore*`, `TerminalPane*`, Rust files, tab/split layout code, package manifests, or unrelated dirty code. Respect all current uncommitted work. Before editing, inspect the live source and existing tests rather than relying on prior summaries.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: TerminalEventBus must continue processing incoming output immediately for bounded replay and activity/title state. Only the xterm write boundary may coalesce chunks. Per renderer, multiple outputs received before one rAF must become one `terminal.write` call in original order; no cross-session mixing. Pending callbacks must be cancelled and no write may occur after `updateSession` rebinding or `destroy`. Use an explicit bounded queue policy only if it cannot reorder or silently lose data; document that policy in code/tests. Maintain replay-before-live ordering when a subscription starts.
RED PROOF: Add one deterministic test with a requestAnimationFrame fixture that asserts three same-frame chunks cause zero immediate writes and exactly one ordered write after frame flush. Run `bun run --cwd ui test -- terminalHostManager` and capture the expected failure caused by the pre-existing direct write behavior before production code.
GREEN PROOF: Implement the smallest typed change, rerun the same command and capture pass. Then run the narrow host-manager test suite once more after any final mutation. Do not fake rAF using fixed sleeps or weakened assertions.
VERIFY: Check TypeScript diagnostics for your changed files if available. Report pre-existing unrelated diagnostics separately.
STOP WHEN: RED and GREEN output-batching evidence exists, changed files are formatted consistently with local code, and no test process remains running.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement or strengthen the state-only navigation regression proof for Ferryx at five parked workspaces with 20 live terminal tabs each.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx` and, only if the source test proves the fast path is absent, the smallest corresponding part of `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`. Return exact changed paths, mutation RED evidence (or normal RED if behavior is initially absent), GREEN command transcript, and the explicit no-spawn/no-wait assertions.
SCOPE: Do not touch terminal renderer files, `TerminalPane*`, Rust, tab drag/drop code, layout code, or package manifests. Existing workspace-store changes are potentially owned by another worker: inspect before editing and make a minimal additive test with no broad formatting/rewrite.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: With five parked layouts containing 20 already-live sessions/tabs each, activating known parked workspaces and tabs must be state-only: no `spawnTerminal`, `closeTerminal`, `waitForTerminalExit`, network/IPC work, or PTY creation; target active layout/state must be correct. The test must be deterministic and must not use time sleeps.
RED PROOF: If the fast path is already correct, this is TEST-ONLY work: add a characterization/regression test, temporarily mutate the exact navigation seam (without committing it) so the new no-spawn/state assertions fail for the intended reason, capture that RED output, then restore the code and run GREEN. If the fast path is not correct, add a natural failing test first. Do not claim a passing new test alone is RED proof.
GREEN PROOF: Run the narrowest Vitest command that executes this test, showing it passes after restoration/implementation. Avoid touching unrelated pre-existing changes.
VERIFY: Type-check/diagnose the modified test/source if supported and report unrelated existing diagnostics separately.
STOP WHEN: A deterministic five-by-twenty state-only navigation regression test passes and its valid RED/GREEN evidence is returned.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement Ferryx terminal renderer lifetime scaling after the output-batching implementation is complete.
DELIVERABLE: Modify `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts`, `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts`, and `ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx` only as needed to enforce visible-only renderers plus a bounded LRU warm cache. Return exact changed paths, RED/ GREEN output, and an explanation of PTY preservation and inactive output behavior.
SCOPE: You depend on the preceding output-batching node: inspect its final code rather than overwriting it. Do not modify workspace state, Rust, remote/mobile protocol, tab drag/drop/layout code, or package manifests. Preserve existing unrelated dirty edits.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: All mounted split panes are pinned visible and never evicted. On an unmounted pane, suspend/unsubscribe its xterm output handling while `TerminalEventBus` continues bounded replay/title/activity processing. Keep a small explicit bounded LRU cache of inactive xterm renderer instances. Evict the least-recently-used inactive renderer by disposing frontend renderer resources and subscriptions only—never close or destroy the associated backend PTY/session. On a warm or recreated renderer becoming visible, reset/replay safely so stale output is not duplicated and replay order precedes live events. Track/cancel pending output scheduling on lifecycle changes. Make the configured warm cache bound independently testable without production-only test hacks.
RED PROOF: Add deterministic host-manager/TerminalPane coverage that initially fails because there is no LRU cap or inactivity suspension. It must create visible split sessions plus more inactive sessions than the configured warm budget, demonstrate the oldest inactive frontend renderer is disposed, visible instances remain, and its backendSessionId/session record is not closed. Run `bun run --cwd ui test -- terminalHostManager` to capture this RED result before implementation.
GREEN PROOF: Implement the smallest strict TypeScript change, run the same tests to green. Include a test showing suspended inactive output is replayed in correct order upon reactivation without direct background terminal writes. No fixed sleeps.
VERIFY: Run diagnostics on each changed TS/TSX file if available and report pre-existing unrelated diagnostic failures distinctly.
STOP WHEN: Renderer budget, visible split pinning, inactivity output suspension/replay, PTY preservation, and RED→GREEN test evidence are complete.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Verify the completed Ferryx terminal scaling changes as an integration gate; do not make feature edits unless a test failure directly proves a local, trivial correction is necessary.
DELIVERABLE: Return exact command outputs and changed paths if any corrective edit is strictly needed. Validate all stated scale contracts, report failures/pre-existing issues separately, and leave no server/test process alive.
SCOPE: Inspect the completed implementations in `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts`, `ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx`, `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`, their tests, and the native output hub/remote code. Preserve unrelated dirty work. Do not commit.
VERIFY COMMANDS: Run targeted relevant UI tests (at minimum terminalHostManager and workspaceStore; include terminalEvents when affected), `bun run --cwd ui build`, and the narrow native command `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml terminal::output_hub` (expand only if this filter does not select the relevant existing tests). Check diagnostics for changed files. Confirm by source inspection that remote streaming still uses the Rust bounded output hub and that no mobile wire contract changed.
REAL-SURFACE: Attempt the closest available real Ferryx browser/UI surface with a concrete command or existing project QA tool. If desktop UI automation cannot be used without violating existing user constraints, do not pretend it passed: return the exact manual steps needed to exercise switching a retained tab and an evicted renderer, and identify why automated desktop evidence is unavailable.
STOP WHEN: Every runnable command result and the real-surface/manual-QA disposition is recorded with exit codes, blockers are distinguished from pre-existing failures, and no process remains running.
